_comment: Texture sets generated with the local ComfyUI toolkit (Z-Image Turbo, then the CPU 'seamless' step that makes the image tileable and derives normal + roughness maps). Colours and patterns follow the palette tables in research/00-consolidated.md section 9, which were sampled from real photographs of K-Arena Yokohama. tile = real-world size in metres that one texture repeat covers. Run: node tools/gen/run-textures.mjs [set ...]
style: seamless tileable material texture, flat orthographic straight-on view, perfectly uniform even diffuse lighting, no shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no perspective, no objects, no text, fills the whole frame edge to edge, photorealistic, high detail
